newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai rice ends mixed in active trade.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai rice ends mixed in active trade.

text.p: Shanghai rice futures ended mixed in active trade on Monday, with institutions continuing to dominate market movements, traders said.
The key September 1996 contract ended at 2,516 ($303) per tonne, rising 20 yuan. It opened at limit-up of 2,586 but fell sharply for the rest of the session.
Combined volume rose sharply to 46,200 tonnes from 1,100 tonnes.
Traders said institutions held a large proportion of open-interest positions, making it easy for them to control the market.
"Institutions wanted to make profits from the sharp price movements," one trader said. "They squeezed out many individual stop-loss orders."
Traders said it was very difficult to tell market direction in the short term, with institutions controlling the market.
